To this end, we applied the limited proteolysis-mass spectrometry (LiP-MS) strategy to saliva samples from healthy individuals compared to saliva samples from OSCC patients with or without lymph node metastasis.

inferred: Saliva is a promising fluid for biomarker investigation because it reflects pathological and physiological alterations in local and distant parts of the body, representing a more accessible screening tool that can be repeatedly monitored over time.
